scenarios.scenario_abstract: Although [X] wakes on time, mind-wandering often consumes part of the morning, so the next day's top and jacket are laid out in advance while [X] records which dressing sequence can be completed from a visible checklist without pausing to align, fasten, readjust, or restart.
examples: using Pull-On when one direct entry best preserves momentum
using Button, Snap, or Zipper only when the user can complete and check the sequence within the timed block
using Drawstring or Tie only when useful adjustment outweighs another morning decision
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]虽能按时起床，却常因走神耽误早晨的准备，因此会提前摆好第二天的上装和外套，并记录哪种穿衣顺序能按可见清单一次完成，而不会因对齐、扣合、重新调整或返工而停顿。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to build an outfit around an owned thin black bomber jacket, wearing it open over a grey base and repeatedly opening or securing it as wind and indoor temperature change while checking whether the closure is easy to find and operate without disturbing the layers.
examples: using Zipper when one continuous action controls the familiar bomber
leaving the exact jacket open when ventilation and visible layering matter
judging the owned jacket from repeated operation rather than from a generic feature list
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在阴冷天气里，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会围绕已有的轻薄黑色飞行夹克搭配灰色内层，并随风势和室内温度变化反复敞开或扣合这件外套，同时观察闭合结构是否容易找到、操作且不会弄乱叠穿层次。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before machine-washing an existing suit, [X] checks the care label and structure, empties every pocket, secures the jacket's actual front hardware, turns the garment inside out, and places it in a mesh bag, using professional cleaning instead if the closure or internal construction cannot tolerate the cycle.
examples: checking each Button or Snap on the familiar jacket before washing
closing a Zipper only when the owned suit actually has one
not inventing an alternative closure merely to cover the value domain
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在把现有的一套西装放入洗衣机前，[X]会检查洗标和结构，清空口袋、固定西装外套真实存在的前部五金、翻面并装入洗衣袋；如果闭合结构或内部构造无法承受机洗，就改送专业清洁。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing for Umrah with a partner and two toddlers, including a child with cerebral palsy who uses a stroller, [X] chooses easy-on prayer tops that a caregiver can manage during crowded transfers among stroller, carrier, and borrowed wheelchair without adding heat, fine-motor work, or delay.
examples: using Pull-On for a short one-handed dressing sequence
using a large Zipper or Snap only when it can be reached and verified quickly
avoiding multiple small Buttons, Ties, or Drawstrings when caregiver attention is divided
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与伴侣带两个幼儿准备副朝时，其中一名脑瘫儿童使用婴儿车；[X]会选择照护者能在婴儿车、背带和借用轮椅之间拥挤转换时轻松穿脱的祈祷上装，避免增加闷热、精细手部操作或延误。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To foster a child's independence, [X] offers two shirts during a stable morning routine and waits while the child orients the chosen top, finds its entry and fasteners, corrects one mistake, and finishes without [X] taking over, using completion rather than speed alone to set the next skill step.
examples: starting with Pull-On when full independent completion is the immediate goal
introducing large Buttons or Snaps after garment orientation is reliable
saving a long Zipper, Drawstring, or Tie sequence for a later dexterity step when needed
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了培养孩子的独立性，[X]会在固定晨间流程中提供两件衬衫选择，并等待孩子自己辨认衣服方向、找到入口和扣合点、纠正一次错误并完成穿衣，不替孩子接手；下一技能阶段由是否完整完成而非只看速度决定。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When turning a mental image into a first handmade top, [X] selects a simple pattern, makes a muslin, and tests the entry opening before cutting final fabric, comparing buttons or snaps, a zipper, an adjustable tie, and a pull-on construction by the intended silhouette, fit adjustment, sewing difficulty, and dressing sequence.
examples: using Pull-On when stretch and neckline opening make separate hardware unnecessary
testing Button, Snap, or Zipper placement in the muslin before final fabric
using Drawstring or Tie only when real adjustment belongs to the design rather than being decorative clutter
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把脑海中的第一件上装变成实物时，[X]会先选择简易纸样、制作坯布样衣并在裁剪正式面料前测试穿入口，再结合目标轮廓、合体调整、缝制难度和穿衣顺序，比较纽扣或按扣、拉链、可调系带和直接套穿等开合方式。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a low-cost spring-and-fall capsule around a white collared shirt, [X] wears it open over a tank on warm afternoons and fully secured beneath a sweater on cold mornings, then checks whether the same front construction remains useful across both arrangements.
examples: using Button for staged opening and full closure of the collared layer
using Snap or Zipper only if the later target preserves the same removable-layer behavior
keeping the base top Pull-On when the outer shirt will be removed repeatedly
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕白色有领衬衫建立低成本春秋胶囊衣橱时，[X]会在暖和的下午把衬衫敞开穿在背心外，寒冷早晨则完全扣好后再加毛衣，并检验同一种前部结构能否适应两种安排。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon campus reunion, [X] starts with familiar dark jeans and casual shoes, then tries tops already in the wardrobe. By comparing how each sweater, polo, or light overshirt goes on, fastens, and adjusts, [X] finds the option that looks one step more polished while remaining comfortable for a walk across campus and a long seated catch-up.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加下午在校园举行、没有着装规定的同学会时，[X]会从熟悉的深色牛仔裤和休闲鞋出发，再试穿衣橱里现有的上装；通过比较每件毛衣、Polo 衫或轻薄罩衫的穿脱、扣合与调节方式，[X]找出既比平日稍显利落，又适合校园步行和长时间坐着叙旧的一件。
examples: using Pull-On when a familiar sweater gives the needed polish with the fewest dressing steps
using Button on a polo or overshirt when partial opening helps tune formality and comfort
using Zipper on a light layer when quick temperature adjustment matters during the campus visit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] chooses a breathable base and a lightweight flannel, button-up overshirt, or bomber layer that can be secured in a windy stand, opened while dancing, and tied or carried when warm, avoiding any closure that catches jewelry, hair, a phone tether, or a clear-bag strap.
examples: using Button, Snap, or Zipper for a removable outer layer that must stay secure in wind
using Pull-On for the breathable base that remains after the layer comes off
checking Drawstring or Tie ends against phone and bag security rather than treating them as decoration only
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会选择透气内层和轻薄法兰绒、纽扣罩衫或飞行夹克外层，使其能在有风看台上固定、跳舞时敞开、变热时系在身上或携带，同时避开会勾住首饰、头发、手机防丢绳或透明包肩带的闭合结构。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building Victorian or steampunk cosplay from modern items, [X] creates a toe-to-head dressing script and pack/build checklist for each torso layer, recording fastening, dressing order, pressure, mobility, repair kit, test status, and whether later layers block access before shopping for or modifying components.
examples: using Button, Snap, or Zipper only where the layer remains reachable in sequence
using Drawstring or Tie when adjustment is needed across stacked layers
using Pull-On for a base top only when later armor can still be donned and removed safely
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用现代单品制作维多利亚或蒸汽朋克 cosplay 时，[X]会为每个躯干层建立从脚到头的穿戴脚本和制作打包清单，在购买或改造组件前记录闭合方式、穿戴顺序、压迫、活动度、维修包、测试状态以及后续层是否遮挡操作。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A prospective Indian sewing-center owner compares a lean home setup with a market shop, deciding whether expected blouse, choli, western-wear, and alteration demand justifies buttonhole and closure-repair capability now or whether simpler top constructions should finance later equipment.
examples: adding Button and buttonhole work only when repeated orders justify the machine
pricing Zipper and Snap repair as distinct services after demand is measured
starting with Pull-On, Drawstring, or Tie constructions when they match the intended garments and available equipment
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名计划在印度开设缝纫中心的经营者比较居家精简起步与市场店铺，判断预期的女衫、choli、西式服装和改衣需求是否足以立即配置扣眼及闭合维修能力，还是先用结构更简单的上装业务为后续设备扩张积累资金。
